R code used to generate Figure XXXX

```{r, eval = F}
.vsc.attach()
setwd("R-QSS/finite_sim")
```

```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(khroma)

config = "rust_config.json"

source("utils.R")
```

## direct comparison to infinite at sigma = 0.01
```{r start}
desc <- "mut_0.01_comp"

n = 4
sigma = -2
theta = -2
desc <- paste0("N_E", n, "_sigma_E", sigma, "_theta_E", theta)
result <- paste0("results/example", desc, ".csv")
if (!file.exists(result)) {
  writeConfig(
    config,
    desc,
    replicates = 10,
    rounds = 1e7,
    write_every = 100,
    seed = 93117,
    pop_size = 10^n,
    patch_lifetime = 10000,
    mort_to_disp = 24.1225,
    uniform_fraction = 0,
    max_biomass = 121.012,
    mut_prob = 10^theta,
    mut_stdev = 10^sigma,
    mut_range = c(0, 1),
    initial = list(
      list(alpha = 0.109, patches = 900)
      )
  )
  command <- sprintf(
    r"[cargo run --release --manifest-path ../../rust-finite/Cargo.toml -- %s %s]",
    config, result
  )
  code <- system(command)
}

points <- read.csv(result, comment.char = "#")
```

```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
pltpoints <- subset(points, round < 500000 & round %% 100 == 0)

tol = khroma::color("iridescent")

plt1 <- ggplot(pltpoints, aes(x = round, y = alpha, color = patch_count)) +
#plt1 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.001, stroke = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation round",
    y = "Siderophore investment α of surviving strains",
    color = "Occupied\npatches\n"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = tol(23)[10:23],
                        trans = "log",
                        limits = c(1, 10000),
                        breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.8)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, text = element_text(family = "sans"))

plt1
```

```{r}
datapoints <- subset(points, time > 1e7)
```

```{r}
# Calculate total siderophore production
production <- aggregate(alpha * pressure ~ time, data = points, FUN = sum)
names(production) <- c("time", "total_sid")

plt2 <- ggplot(production, aes(x = time, y = total_sid)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation time",
    y = "Total siderophore production"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.7, 0.8)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, text = element_text(family = "sans"))
plt2
```

```{r}
# Calculate number of strains
strainnr <- as.data.frame(table(points$time))
names(strainnr) <- c("time", "total")
strainnr$time <- as.numeric(as.character(strainnr$time))

plt5 <- ggplot(strainnr, aes(x = time, y = total)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.01) +

    x = "Simulation time",
    y = "Number of coexisting strains"
  ) +

plt5
```

```{r}
# Histogram of alpha
plt6 <- ggplot(subset(points, time > 0), aes(x = alpha, weight = pressure)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0.109, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count / sum(count))), binwidth=0.002) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Siderophore investment α",
    y = "Fraction of total biomass across simulation"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian( xlim = c(0, 0.11))

plt6
```

Assemble SI figure
```{r}
plot_list <- list(plt1, plt2, plt3, plt4, plt5, plt6)

plot <- plot_grid( # cowplot
  plotlist = plot_list,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 3,
  align = "hv",
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  label_size = 12,
  label_fontface = "bold",
  label_fontfamily = "sans"
)

save_plot(
  filename = "results/smallmut_SI.png", 
  plot = plot,
  base_height = 10,
  base_width = 7, 
  dpi = 300,
)
```
